t: You Can't Buy Love | San Diego Reader
s: Would I wonder why the heck someone kept buying me stuff all the time? Yes! Would I think that they were expecting something big in return? Definitely! For me, giving was never about receiving something material in return. I didn’t gifts, all I wanted was love. It did made me feel good to give, but I gave for all the wrong reason and I went a little overboard. If someone really loves you they’ll love you for you, not for what you can buy them.
